name: American Tire and Motorsports
old_description: Our continued commitment to service, quality and product innovation have established Rampage Products as a significant leader of premium parts and accessories in the specialty Jeep, Truck, SUV and UTV marketplace. Our team of industry enthusiasts not only use our products, but also contribute to the many new ideas and product innovations you can see today on our website and in our catalog. Together we invite you to review our program; use our products; and join our growing family of satisfied customers.
about:
American Tire and Motorsports operates from a facility at 689 McLean Avenue in Yonkers, New York. The company’s founding date and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The business functions as a retailer and installer of aftermarket parts and accessories for pickup trucks, SUVs, and off-road vehicles. Its service offerings include custom fabrication projects, interior and exterior coating applications, and DINITROL rust proofing. The company stocks and sells products from brands such as Rampage Products, Buyers Products Company, and ZROADZ Off Road Products, and promotes a “buy a part, we can install it” model for customers.

Its customer base spans automotive aftermarket enthusiasts and commercial fleets seeking upgrades in categories including automotive lighting, bumpers and grille guards, cargo management, suspension, towing accessories, truck bed covers, wheels and tires, winches, and bedliners. The company also lists public safety and promotional equipment among its product lines.
